Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday 08:00 digest, and nothing is scheduled. I replied in your thread in #coastal-team to say so.

I did create a scheduled job, then removed it. The scheduler isn't running, it works in UTC rather than Central, and it can't post into Slack. It wouldn't have fired at 08:00 Central, and it wouldn't have posted anything even if it had fired.

I can post a "Coastal week ahead" digest whenever someone asks me. It would cover last week's items from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. A Monday 08:00 post would need an admin to enable scheduled posting for me. I asked whether you want a one-off digest now or want me to ask an admin.
